acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Lizardfolk family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Scout, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Tail-Balance Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Small, lean, mud-caked, and explicitly crestless with a bone spear and simple hide wrap.
Signature mechanic: Countertail Jab: the Scout swings its long tail opposite the upcoming spear thrust, committing both body axes.
battlefieldDuty: Probe lateral spacing with one bone-spear feint whose true thrust follows the counterbalancing tail.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe construction: T1 Scout uses a mineral-capped bone spear, grit-stiffened hide wrap, fitted guards on existing scale rows, a tail counterweight, and wedges beneath planted feet; T2 Warrior may laminate its shield and low crest; T3–T5 may place crystal wedges between mature dorsal plates and heavier natural armor.
Locomotion becomes load-bearing through the T1 planted foot and fractured spear cap, the T2 shield anchor, and T3–T5 compressed strata at the active dorsal wedge or tail weight.
counterplay: Step toward the moving tail rather than the spear and strike the planted rear foot during the fixed jab. Affinity signal: T1 Scout locks one planted foot into a mineral ring while the bone spear cap turns chalk-white; T2 Warrior exposes its low-crest or shield anchor, while T3–T5 expose the loaded dorsal wedge before release.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only brown scales or extra mud without fitted mineral structure
Glow-only earth treatment without anchors, weight, and fractures
Ordinary swamp mud presented alone as Earth affinity
Stone bulk that erases the agile reptilian silhouette
identityInvariants: An upright forward-leaning reptilian body keeps clawed hands and feet, a long counterbalancing tail, a crocodilian or iguana-like head, and an escalating dorsal ridge.
Swamp green, mud brown, moss, and ochre are punctuated by warning-bright orange, red, or yellow throat and crest colors.
Scale, bone, obsidian, hide, river reed, ordinary mud, and feather remain separately legible materials.
Paint, bone piercings, trophy skulls, woven shields, and feather headdresses accumulate without obscuring natural plating.
Tail angle, crest posture, dorsal plates, hands, and planted feet preserve the direction and recovery of each attack.
telegraph: Ordinary mud flakes from the lean body, the simple hide wrap twists, and the long tail sweeps away from the bone spear.
